supporting_observations.claim: At 13:42:20–13:42:26 UTC, WS-MFISCHER-01 (10.55.10.22) made two LDAP connections to 10.55.20.10, identified by nearby DNS evidence as DC-SUN-01. The first LDAP connection returned 47,049 bytes. This is temporally relevant to the alert, but the records do not show the LDAP operation or prove that it created adm_temp.
WS-MFISCHER-01 also contacted the domain controller over Kerberos at 13:42:57 UTC; the network record does not identify which account authenticated or what action followed.

The available records show directory-related network activity from a workstation assigned to max.fischer close to the alerted time, but do not establish that max.fischer, that workstation, or any particular process created adm_temp.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection for WS-MFISCHER-01 and DC-SUN-01 was unavailable for the full 13:20–14:20 UTC window because of a collection outage.
Network telemetry records connections and byte counts here, but does not expose the LDAP operation, the account performing it, or the process that initiated it.
The supplied records do not include a direct account-creation event for adm_temp.
claims_not_established: Whether adm_temp was actually created at the reported time, and which identity or process performed the creation.
Whether adm_temp was added to any groups, granted privileges, or used after creation.
Whether the directory activity from WS-MFISCHER-01 is related to the account alert or was authorized.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve DC-SUN-01 directory audit records for the window, especially account creation and group-membership or privilege-change events, including the actor and target account.
Recover or obtain endpoint process and security logs for WS-MFISCHER-01 and DC-SUN-01 for the window, including process command lines and logon identities.
Check the account's current and historical attributes, group memberships, and sign-in or use history.
Verify whether a help-desk request or other approved change authorized this account and its naming and access level.
unrelated_findings: At 13:22:54 UTC, WS-MFISCHER-01 was recorded as the source workstation for a Kerberos network logon to WS-ZADAMS-01 targeting zoe.adams; the supplied evidence does not connect this event to adm_temp. Review separately if appropriate. (T227-00007)

WS-MFISCHER-01 resolved afemode.sunridge.local to 10.55.20.115 and then made a connection attempt to that host on TCP/1433; the connection record shows no data exchanged. This is not established as related to the alert. (T227-00214, T227-00224)
WS-MFISCHER-01 resolved doh.opendns.com during the review window. The record establishes a DNS lookup, not use of a DNS-over-HTTPS service. (T227-00258)
